up: List all approved drugs whose mechanism of action is classified as a chelating agent. For each drug, return the following information: the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), the mechanism of action description (mechanism_of_action), the canonical SMILES string (canonical_smiles), and the target ChEMBL ID (target_chembl_id). Only include drugs where max_phase is 4 and the action_type is 'CHELATING AGENT'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, dm.mechanism_of_action, cs.canonical_smiles, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'CHELATING AGENT';
